{{Icon|Susceptibility icon|text=false|nolink=true}} [[Susceptibility]] is a category of debuffs inflicted to enemies in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

As of October 2026, there are currently no operators who directly apply Susceptibility, although it appears as an icon through enemies affected by {{Icon|Ardelia icon|[[Ardelia]]'s}} Battle Skill {{Color|Dolly Rush|7}} which applies both {{G|Physical Susceptibility}} and {{G|Arts Susceptibility}}. Applying both types of Susceptibility through different operators does not show the icon.

When enemies are inflicted with a type of '''Susceptibility''', they temporarily take more damage for a set duration based on the type inflicted and the [[Element]] of the incoming damage type. The number represents the degree of increase.

An enemy that is considered '''Arts Susceptible''' is also considered Susceptible to all Arts Elements. For example, while {{Icon|Avywenna icon|[[Avywenna]]'s}} {{Icon|Potential 5|{{Color|Carrot and Sharp Stick|7}}}} only explicitly states that it is triggered from enemies that are {{G|Electric Susceptibility|Electric Susceptible}}, applying Arts Susceptibility to the target also triggers this Potential.

Multiple sources of Susceptibility stack <u>additively</u> to form the '''Susceptibility Multiplier''' for that damage instance. The resulting Susceptibility Mulitplier then stacks <u>multiplicatively</u> with other damage multipliers to get the final value. For more information on calculating damage, see [[Damage calculation]].
